source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary: Once each turn, in your opponent's [Shooting phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), after any enemy unit shoots at a friendly **NECRONS** unit, 1 model with this ability 3" or less from that unit can shoot as though in your Shooting phase, but only at the attacker and only if it is an eligible target.

reminder.unresolved: Withheld as a class: independent reviews found 4 of 86 sampled reminders of unit abilities wrong or partly wrong, above the 2% this reading may ship with.

trigger.event: enemy unit targets friendly NECRONS unit
